theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners (GDX) is the cleanest trend-gated theme in the current set: eligible, hurst_tag 'trend', full breadth (1.0), durability_bar 0.8, and not crowded (z=0.4). With the absolute-trend gate the only validated risk-control edge, this theme's trend-health reading is the most supportive of a directional lean among the leaders. The rank (3) supports focus, not alpha; durability + trend-health is the leg carrying the view.
evidence: trend_gate: eligible=true with hurst_tag 'trend' and durability_bar 0.8
rank 3, score 1.582 — leadership focus without being the fading top name
theses.dissent: Gold miners are a macro/sentiment beta more than an earnings-cohesion trade; a firm risk-on tape (AI tech re-acceleration) would pull relative flow away from precious metals and GDX could lag despite clean trend internals.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM & Storage leads the ranks but the detector shows a fading profile at the top: r10 -0.1256, breadth only 0.25, val_state 'fading', and hurst 'mixed'. Durability_bar is a modest 0.51. The rotation leader/challenger margin is thin (0.35) with Silver Miners showing full breadth and better trend-health — a confirmed handoff is NOT yet declared, but the leader's cohesion is poor, so a directional lean here has no support beyond the raw rank.
evidence: rotation margin only 0.35 vs Silver Miners (no decisive lead)
theses.dissent: The name is still rank 1 with a large raw score (2.265) and AI-infrastructure memory (HBM) demand is a persistent structural story; the 'fading' tag could be a short-term pullback inside an intact uptrend that resumes.

falsifier.text: SMH makes a new 20-day high while Memory/HBM breadth remains below 0.5

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity (CIBR) reads as the most extended theme in the set: crowded=true with crowding_z 1.93 (highest in the ranks) alongside full breadth and a trend tag. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-DOWN caution only — never a fade or short — so the honest expression is a low-conviction underweight relative to non-crowded trend themes, not a bet against the theme. No reason to add directional alpha belief here.
evidence: durability_bar 0.86 and hurst 'trend' (trend is intact, but extension is high)
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity is a defensive-growth software complex with stable recurring revenue; crowded positioning can persist for long stretches in a slow-tape environment without a drawdown, making an underweight a relative miss rather than an outright gain.

falsifier.text: CIBR outperforms SPY by more than 5% over the next 30 trading days without a crowding unwind
